title: Design Assurance Quality Engineer
description:
Role: Design Assurance Quality Engineer - New Product Development
Location: Europe (Open to Location) - Remote Worker with ad hoc travel
Employment: Permanent
Come build something that matters.
It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®.
The Job:
The Design Assurance Quality Engineer supports new product development activities by ensuring quality is built into product design, development, system, verification, validation, and launch processes. This role partners cross-functionally with engineering, R&D, manufacturing, sourcing, and regulatory/compliance teams to identify risks early, implement robust controls, and ensure new products meet customer, business, and applicable quality requirements.
The position plays a key role in design quality planning and strategy, risk management, design reviews, and verification and validation support.
Key Responsibilities:

• Act as the Quality subject matter expert within cross-functional New Product Development (NPD) teams.

• Embed quality requirements throughout the product development lifecycle, from concept through commercialization.

• Lead quality planning activities, including Design Quality Plans, Control Plans, inspection strategies, and defect prevention initiatives.

• Drive risk management through DFMEA, PFMEA, hazard analysis, FRACA, and robust mitigation planning.

• Facilitate design and process reviews, ensuring quality, reliability, and customer requirements are built into product designs.

• Develop and execute verification and validation strategies to ensure products meet critical-to-quality (CTQ) requirements.

• Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Supplier Quality teams to ensure successful design transfer and production readiness.

• Lead structured problem-solving, root cause analysis, and corrective actions during product development and launch.

• Ensure compliance with internal quality systems, industry standards, APQP requirements, and change control processes.

• Use data, statistical methods, and lessons learned to monitor quality performance and drive continuous improvement across NPD projects

The Person:
You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. In fact, you embrace it. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? You also have:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or related technical discipline.

• Demonstrable experience in quality engineering, design assurance, new product development and well-established NPD systems.

• Proven experience driving Continuous Improvement initiatives using Lean Six Sigma or equivalent quality methodologies

• Experience using quality and product data systems such as Minitab, PLM, ERP, or QMS platforms.

• Knowledge of APQP, PPAP, design controls, and product lifecycle management processes.

• ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Lean Six Sigma, or similar certification.

• Effective English written and verbal communication skills

The Details:
We want our company to be a place you’ll want to be - and stay. Being part of our team means you’ll get to:
Grow: Be part of our global company with 20+ brands to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.
Learn: Have access to a wealth of learning resources, including our digital learning portal.
Belong: Experience an awesome place to work, where we have mutual respect and a great appreciation for a wide range of perspectives and experiences.

title: Temporary Senior Accountant
description:
THE ROLE: TEMPORARY SENIOR ACCOUNTANT
OLLY is seeking a detail-oriented, hands-on Temporary Senior Accountant to support our Accounting team, with a focus on DTC and Amazon revenue accounting, reconciliations, and month-end close. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys digging into the details, and can quickly take ownership of accounting processes.

• Manage Shopify DTC revenue accounting, including sales, refunds, chargebacks, gift cards, shipping revenue, and deferred revenue in accordance with US GAAP.

We are looking for a proactive, resourceful accountant who can hit the ground running, navigate complex reconciliations, and help keep our accounting operations running smoothly. Someone who is comfortable getting into the details, solving problems, and collaborating with teams across the business.
​ CAPABILITIES + SKILLS REQUIRED ​

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

• 4+ years of accounting experience, including month-end close, journal entries, and account reconciliations.

• Strong understanding of US GAAP, revenue recognition, and accrual accounting.

• Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large transactional datasets.

• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently in a remote environment.

• Experience with Shopify, Amazon Vendor Central, e-commerce accounting, or CPG preferred.

• Experience with Paylocity, payroll reporting, or multi-state payroll tax registration a plus.

THE DETAILS
LOCATION: Remote​
HOURS: 40 hours/ week, 3-6 month assignment​
PLEASE NOTE: Candidates must be authorized to work in the UnitedStates without sponsorship. For all OLLY positions. Religious and/or medical accommodations will be considered on a case-by-case basis.
The pay range for this position is $56.00 - $62.00/hour​

This position is within the IFT Technical Services (IFT-TS) Distributed Systems Testing (DST) Team, a team that primarily supports Logos, while also contributing to other IFT projects.
The role
We are seeking an experienced Distributed Systems Evaluation Engineer to join the Institute of Free Technology - Technical Services, on the Distributed Systems Testing (IFT-TS DST) team. This role focuses on rigorously assessing the performance and reliability of IFT projects at scale, where Logos (λ) is one of them.
Logos (λ) technology stack is composed of 3 main components:

•
Logos (λ) Blockchain : Advanced privacy for a new era of decentralised applications and social institutions.

•
Logos (λ) Messaging : Private peer‑to‑peer communication that resists surveillance and censorship.

•
Logos (λ) Storage : Secure decentralised storage enabling fully decentralised apps and file sharing.

We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic DevOps Engineer to join our Distributed Systems Testing (DST) team.
You’ll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive evaluation strategies, leveraging both large-scale lab deployments and protocol behavior modeling scripts. Your expertise will be crucial in analyzing these complex distributed systems, automating intricate test scenarios, and providing in-depth insights into system behaviors.
Working closely with cross-functional teams, you’ll troubleshoot complex issues and translate technical data into actionable recommendations. Proficiency in containerization, cloud technologies, and distributed systems principles is essential.
Key responsibilities

• Design, configure, and optimize Kubernetes clusters to support large-scale experiments and benchmarks of P2P technologies.

• Continuously improve cluster scalability and resource utilization, enabling increasingly complex deployments and experiments.

• Set up, maintain, and optimize supporting infrastructure such as monitoring, logging, and observability stacks (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, etc.).

• Collaborate with DST researchers and engineers to streamline experimentation workflows and make analysis easier and more reproducible.

• Automate infrastructure and deployment workflows to increase reliability and reduce overhead.

• Troubleshoot, profile, and tune distributed workloads to ensure accurate and performant benchmarking.

• Identify, reproduce, and debug complex issues in distributed systems, working closely with Logos development teams.

You ideally will have

• Strong experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration in production or research environments.

• Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure, Linux systems, and networking (especially relevant to distributed/P2P systems).

• Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Grafana, Prometheus, VictoriaLogs, etc.).

• Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, Helm, etc.).

• Proficiency in at least one scripting/programming language (ideally Python).

• Interest in or experience with distributed systems, P2P networks, or blockchain technologies.

• Experience with networks and systems programming.

• Excellent written and conversational communication skills.

• Alignment with our core values and principles.

Bonus points

• Hands-on experience with libp2p or projects in the Logos collective.

• Background in performance benchmarking, scalability testing, or systems research.

• Contributions to open source projects.

• Experience working for an open-source organization.

Interview Process

• Interview with team member from the IFT-TS DST team

With an AI-enabled edge processing and a variety of radars and sensors with continuous 360 pan / tilt capability, Sentry can autonomously identify, detect, and track objects of interest to bring increased awareness to borders, military bases, oil and gas pipelines, airports and other critical infrastructure.

title: Senior Systems Software Engineer
description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.   The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. The Role We build the control chain that powers on, monitors, updates, and protects devices and racks across bare metal, RTOS, and embedded Linux. It’s production-critical software that keeps racks stable, updates safe, and hardware secure. It’s a critical layer in turning a tokens per second benchmark into a tokens per month system, turning great silicon into reliable output at rack scale. You’ll be there for the first racks coming to life and rollout days where update safety matters. Your work makes the difference between a bad failure and a clean recovery path. This is a software-engineering-first role for someone with real machine learning deployment experience: you'll design, build and run the infrastructure that serves our computer vision and multimodal models in production.

 

Our platform is moving from manual, GUI-heavy annotation towards ML-driven workflows, where models do more of the work and learn from annotator feedback. Your job is to make that possible by turning our models into fast, dependable product features.

 

Our ML team covers both research and engineering, and this role sits firmly on the engineering side. You'll own architecture, implementation, deployment and production operations, while teammates on the research side focus on longer-horizon experiments and prototypes. Day-to-day, you'll work closely with them, as well as with our Product Engineering and Human Data teams.

- Optimise models and pipelines for production through batching, KV caching, GPU utilisation and orchestration

- Integrate models into Encord's product and annotation workflows together with Product Engineering

- Build reusable abstractions that work across models, data types, customers and changing task templates

- A bridge between research and production. You speak both languages, help researchers get their work shipped, and feed production lessons back into how models are built.

 

Experience requirements

Evergreen Expression of Interest - Rutherford Talent Clearinghouse™
Executive Talent Accelerator Programme
Canada · United States · United Kingdom Put your experience to work developing others

Rutherford International welcomes expressions of interest from experienced executives, professional coaches and subject-matter specialists who can help professionals strengthen their performance, develop their judgement and prepare for greater responsibility.

Through the Executive Talent Accelerator, Rutherford matches assessed employees of enterprise clients with development expertise suited to their objectives, behavioural profiles and organisational circumstances.

This posting recruits independent providers of mentoring, coaching and specialist consulting services. It is an Evergreen Expression of Interest, not a current vacancy or a guaranteed assignment.

Augmenting internal career development

The Executive Talent Accelerator augments employers’ internal career and leadership development programmes with dedicated mentoring capacity, structured coaching and targeted specialist expertise.

Annual reviews can establish clear development priorities, but managers’ operational responsibilities may leave limited time for consistent guidance, practice and follow-up. Effective mentoring and coaching also require capabilities and interpersonal qualities that differ from those needed to manage performance.

Rutherford provides additional support to help employees act on agreed development objectives, working alongside their employer’s internal programme.

Three distinct ways to contribute

Executive Mentors

Provide longer-term, holistic guidance grounded in personal experience, career wisdom and relevant leadership responsibilities. Mentors help participants examine career direction, navigate organisational challenges, strengthen judgement and prepare for broader responsibilities.

Effective mentors explain their reasoning, share relevant experience and help participants develop their own judgement.

Executive Coaches

Provide structured, focused support for short-term skill development and performance improvement. Coaches help participants establish specific objectives, practise new approaches and review progress against agreed outcomes.

Assignments may address communication, delegation, stakeholder relationships, leadership behaviours or readiness for a defined responsibility.

Subject-Matter Specialist Consultants

Provide focused expertise addressing a particular functional, technical or business need. Specialists may explain a method, examine a decision, review work or help participants apply unfamiliar knowledge.

The scope, intended contribution and limits of the advice are established for each assignment. Implementation work is agreed separately.

Professionals may offer more than one service. Suitability and engagement scope are considered separately for each role.

Who should register

We welcome:

• Current and former executives with relevant leadership experience and a demonstrated ability to develop others.

• Professional coaches who can explain their methods, qualifications and evidence of contribution.

• Senior functional and technical specialists who can translate expertise into practical learning.

• Experienced consultants interested in supporting enterprise-sponsored development.

A distinguished career or senior title alone does not establish mentoring or coaching capability. We look for evidence that you can listen, explain, challenge appropriately and adapt your approach to another person’s needs.

Assessment and matching

•
Functional expertise: demonstrated knowledge, judgement and relevant exper

title: Staff Decision Scientist, Partner Excellence
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design.

PARTNER EXCELLENCE HIGHLIGHTS

- You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls.

- Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it?

- A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training?

- Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

- A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning.

- Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Staff Decision Scientist, Partner Excellence at Relay, you'll:

- Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

- Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like.

- Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

- Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

- Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

- Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO…

- Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model.

- Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial

description:

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

LOCATION

title: Member of Product Staff, Core Product
description:
ABOUT ABRIDGE

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

THE ROLE

Core Product is responsible for how doctors and nurses use Abridge every day, and how deeply and broadly they engage with it. That covers the notes clinicians rely on after every visit, how care moves across the inpatient stay and the emergency department, the assistant clinicians ask questions of, nursing workflows, and the voice, mobile, and desktop experiences that clinician’s use.

We are hiring a Product Manager to own one of these areas end to end. You'll spend real time with clinicians, turn what you learn into product conviction, and ship with engineering, design, machine learning, and clinical science. Success means clinicians who come back to Abridge again and again, and health systems that can see the time saved and value created.

This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco or New York. Please only apply or consider this opportunity if you are open to Monday, Wednesday, and Friday in office or relocation.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own product strategy and execution for your area. Define the vision and roadmap, decide what to build and what not to build, and own the outcomes.

- Earn clinician love. Do deep discovery with physicians, nurses, and advanced practice providers across ambulatory, inpatient, and ED settings. Test hypotheses quickly and iterate on adoption, retention, and perceived time saved.

- Ship AI experiences clinicians trust. Partner with ML and clinical science to define quality bars and evals. Design for uncertainty and edge cases, and know where AI shouldn't be used.

- Make Abridge part of the workflow. Work across EHR integrations (Epic, Cerner, Meditech) and Abridge's own surfaces so the experience fits how clinicians already work.

- Grow depth and breadth of engagement. Set clear success metrics, such as active use, retention, workflows per clinician, and time saved, and drive them across care settings and roles.

- Prototype to build conviction. Use AI coding tools to sharpen your own thinking and get the team aligned before engineering commits.

- Operate with a high bar for quality, speed, and accountability.

WHAT YOU BRING

- 5+ years of product management experience, including end-to-end ownership of user-facing products you launched, not just optimized.

- Hands-on AI/ML product experience with specifics. You've shipped AI features and have opinions on what makes them good or bad.

- A visible building habit. You prototype, build with AI tools daily, and can show us
